title: Just what my life needed
body: This came in at the time I needed it the most. It is intuitive and easy to use. Aesthetically pleasing and the gentle reminders allow me to do the activity I want to track and then check it off. A very friendly team when support is needed. I would definitely recommend this to anyone. Thanks again!
author: MpodiM
